video_title: Boogie, Chandler & Lou Give RESPECT To Knicks + Can Knicks BEAT Spurs or Thunder??

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Knicks' historic journey to NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: This is by far one of the better Knicks teams. They've shown it all year as far as being a consistent team.
quotes.quote: Obviously you have to say yes, but first off, shout out to the Knicks. It's been a long time coming. We know this is a historic fanbase. They have incredibly crazy fans, super passionate fans. So shout out to them and happy for them for reaching this milestone since 99 like you said, but I would have to agree and say this is one of the better Knicks teams. I can't think in my recent years of a team that I can consider better as far as talent on paper, but when it also comes to what they achieved this season, this is by far one of the better Knicks teams. They've shown it all year as far as being a consistent team. They had their short-comings early on in the season, a lot of people were down on them, but kept their head above water, stayed consistent, stayed mellow throughout the season and now they're at a great point in the season as far as being a finals team. I think they did everything the correct way. I do appreciate allowing the team to build their chemistry, build their camaraderie. One thing that I don't like about current NBA is how quickly teams turn over yearly. This is a team that's been allowed to continue to grow with one another, continue to get better year by year. And now they're to the point where they're a finals team. So shout out to them for doing it the right way. In my opinion, the right way. This has been a consistent team all year and they did the same exact thing throughout the playoffs. So congrats to them.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Knicks' dominant playoff run and rest advantage
quotes.excerpt: You don't usually see an 11-game win streak in the playoffs. And all their wins besides one have been by double digits.
quotes.quote: Yeah, as much fun as it is to go back and forth with Knicks fans and how passionate and crazy they are, you got to give them their respect and this team is rolling. You don't usually see an 11-game win streak in the playoffs. And all their wins besides one have been by double digits. So this team is absolutely rolling. They're healthy besides OG being banged up a little bit in the previous series. They are healthy. They're getting a lot more production from their bench than they have in recent years. Jalen Brunson has just been phenomenal. Landry Shamet, he's been unconscious from threes. So they're getting production from everywhere. They're dominating the offensive glass and just killing it on rebounding and Mitchell Robinson what he's doing off the bench. So this team is rolling. They're on an absolute heater right now and it's the best case scenario because the other two teams on the other side are just beating each other up and looking like they're going game seven. So the Knicks are able to get that rest and get fully healthy and get prepared for either team that they see, but you got to give them their flowers, you got to give them their respect. They are doing it on both sides of the ball. They are not turning it over as much as they were.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on Knicks' impressive playoff run and championship potential
quotes.excerpt: Now you have an opportunity to go out and win a championship and we keep talking about the Spurs and the Thunder like they're untouchable.
quotes.quote: Yeah, like we keep talking about the Western Conference like they untouchable. You got to give credit where it's due. This New York Knicks team, they ain't on that last eight playoff games, 11 and 0 after before that. So, if you look around and what they've been able to accomplish. Let's think about the conversation we were having about this team and their journey, right? At one point, the fans were calling for Mike Brown to be fired. At one point, we were trying to figure out whether Cat was happy or not. We start having trade talks from there. We start talking about chemistry. We start talking about fit. Them not playing their best brand of basketball and in the postseason like that, everybody figures it out and they're all on the same page and they play some of the most impressive basketball that we've seen a New York Knicks play in almost 27, 28 years of basketball. Now you have an opportunity to go out and win a championship and we keep talking about the Spurs and the Thunder like they're untouchable. The Knicks are playing lights out basketball and they're getting a lot of good stuff from a lot of different places and playing with the confidence of any other team that you can think of that can put themselves in this position.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Knicks' proven foundation for future success
quotes.excerpt: In what world would they break this team up or this core up when they've shown that they've had a bunch of success?
quotes.quote: Well, like we just talked about, I think they have the foundation, right? I think they've proven especially in the Eastern Conference that they can be the best team. They can go to the finals for multiple years to come. And we know, the Celtics are always going to be hanging around. The Hawks got better. The Pistons aren't going anywhere. But the Knicks have proven that they can play and beat anybody in the Eastern Conference. And now we always talk about how good the West is and how good those two teams are they're still playing over there and they're always going to have to go through them, but we're talking about a team that just dominated the playoff in the Eastern Conference, cakewalked their way to the NBA finals. In what world would they break this team up or this core up when they've shown that they've had a bunch of success and they add guys like Alvarado and Jordan Clarkson and Shamet and Deuce McBride. Now they have a legit bench too where they're getting production from everywhere. They have great bigs, they have athletic, versatile wings that can do multiple things defensively. So this team is very, very good. They are very talented. They've always had that. They just haven't been the most consistent team like the Pistons were throughout the regular season. That means nothing now because they are on an absolute heater.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' passionate fanbase and Mike Brown's coaching success
quotes.excerpt: The NBA is better when the Knicks are better. It's true.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I think they fully should keep this team together. Mike Brown, I think has solidified his job what he's done with this team and the Knicks are in a really, really good place. And we always say the NBA is better when the Knicks are better. It's true. Think about how much excitement right now, how much fans. I'm in Cabo right now. There's Knicks fans everywhere here.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: So can we put this conversation? Can we put the Tibs conversation in the closet? Are we over there now?

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: I think we have to be.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Yeah, they have to be better.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: For now. Well, but here's the thing. We also I think we I want Tibs to get another job. I still feel think he got the short end of the stick on that one. Because it's not like Mike Brown was their first choice. Remember they went.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: I'll give you. I'll give you.
